description: Post-discovery-first occupational-intelligence structural ceiling for Insight Hub 2 after browser-CI, dead-code hardening, React 19 state-map compatibility, OSHA database-persistence hardening, and the deliberate occupational intelligence expansion. The active application keeps one shell, three global CSS layers, the reviewed component-level style blocks, lazy-loaded workspaces, and the protected Hub 2 intelligence ownership routes. The first-party React 19 state-map workspace replaces the incompatible upstream peer declaration, OSHA summary data uses Postgres persistence, and the discovery-first occupational pass adds a curated discovery API, historical BLS route, OSHA Form 300/301 case-detail persistence/import/analytics, and a bounded Data.gov CKAN datastore workbench. The occupational browser regression suite remains the required guardrail for source-first behavior and removal of pseudo-risk scoring. Duplicate files, generated artifacts, invalid coordinates, extra app shells, new unreachable frontend files, additional architecture candidates, and additional injected-style files remain prohibited unless this baseline is deliberately reviewed and updated.
